note: Topic mask for live_demo --vocab250 (press T to cycle). One of 11 topics whose union covers all 206 of the 250 classes scoring at or above 0.6 on the held-out test -- the same floor topic_everyday.json used, because a topic full of broken words helps nobody. 44 words fall below it and are deliberately unreachable.
mass_min_why: PROVISIONAL, not measured. Out-of-topic rejection: refuse a sign unless at least this much of the model's UNMASKED probability lands on these words. Without it a narrow mask MUST name one of its own words, and on the 123-class medical model that meant 13.6-20.3% of out-of-topic signs were SPOKEN as a wrong word. 0.1 is set to the class-count-scaled equivalent of the 0.20 that measured FREE on the medical model, not to a value measured here. Verify before relying on it.
caveat: UNMEASURED GATE NUMBERS. mean/min_test_acc below are real (word_acc_250.json, macro mean 0.7571 against the known 0.7755 micro figure). first_try, precision, off-topic false speech and mass_min are NOT measured for this model, because the repo has no held-out test SET for it -- sign_clips_250.npz is the per-word exemplar clips, which are TRAINING data and report precision 1.000 at every threshold. The equivalent medical numbers must NOT be transferred: mass is the probability landing on the topic, so a diffuse prediction over 250 classes puts ~25/250 = 0.10 on a 25-word topic against ~25/123 = 0.20 for the 123-class model, which makes the same threshold materially STRICTER here. docs/KAGGLE_250_TOPIC_EVAL.md is the run that fills these in. Until then mass_min is provisional.
